effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (LED7-EN008, Legendary Duelists: Rage of Ra)

changes.historical_text: During the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard, you can activate Trap Cards from your hand.
changes.modern_text: If this card is sent from the Monster Zone to the GY: You can activate 1 Trap Card from your hand this turn. You can only use this effect of "Makyura the Destructor" once per turn.
changes.summary: Functional erratum. Pre-errata, the effect is EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE+EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS on EVENT_TO_GRAVE with no condition and no count limit: it applies by itself whenever Makyura is sent to the Graveyard from anywhere, does not start a Chain, and the field effect it registers has no count limit, so any number of Trap Cards may be activated from the hand for the rest of that turn. The errata'd card is an optional Trigger Effect (EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE+EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O with EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP+EFFECT_FLAG_DELAY) that must be activated, is conditioned on having been sent from the Monster Zone (IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE)), is a hard once per turn (SetCountLimit(1,id)), and grants exactly one Trap activation from the hand (SetCountLimit(1) on the granted field effect).

review.notes: No GOAT variant is shipped; the pre-errata entry is the baseline per the sweep rule. The chain starts at lineage v2 (LCJW-EN121, 2013-10-11), the version the pre-errata entry's text matches exactly. The earlier transitions v0 (DB1-EN169, 2004-10-12) -> v1 (BP01-EN180, 2012-05-24) -> v2 are pronoun and tense rewordings ('the owner of this card' -> 'you', 'Trap Card(s)' -> 'Trap Cards', 'is sent' -> 'was sent') with no behavioural difference, so they sit here rather than in changes; the pre-errata behaviour is identical across all three. Conflict: the pinned cdb modern text is BabelCDB's unofficial OCG-functionality text - it inserts 'You can activate this effect;' and carries the '* The above text is unofficial ...' note - so it matches no English lineage version exactly (best match v3, ratio 0.763). The recorded modern text is taken from lineage v3, the TCG erratum printing. Makyura does not appear on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata list.
